decisions.reason: The GA4 plugin builds directly on the firm's existing shop-plugin and tracking know-how, and GA4 is now the active Google standard, so the firm can learn from early use and keep improving the plugin.
Google retired Universal Analytics in 2023 and 360 properties end in 2024, so the plugin has no future value; the firm's tracking knowledge is better put into the GA4 successor.
A retail system interface plugin draws on the firm's core integration and programming competence, so its customer feedback is easy to absorb and act on.
The SEO relaunch service is prominently presented on its own page and draws on the firm's shop-development expertise, so it fits closely with its established consulting business.
